location: St. George / Boggs Landing Access Ramp, Kansas River, Kansas
coordinateInterpretation: Friends of the Kaw published public ramp GPS point; access-area anchor, not surveyed wet-toe coordinate.

evidence.claim: Friends of the Kaw identifies St. George/Boggs Landing Access Ramp at river mile 137 and publishes GPS 39.18726, -96.42202, exactly matching the shared route point.
evidence.sourceType: Kansas River Water Trail access page

evidence.claim: The access page describes a one-vehicle concrete ramp, parking, restrooms, lighting, and community-developed public access.
The City of St. George lists Boggs Landing Boat Ramp, and KDWP's Kaw River guide lists St. George/Boggs Landing at river mile 137.

The corrected access occurrence is 434 feet from the named NHD flowline on the Junction City route and 208 feet on the Ogden route; both are within mapped-water review distance. The Junction City NHD response remains incomplete.
